metadata.title: Max Planck — The Reluctant Revolutionary
metadata.note: VOXBIO DEMO SLICE — representative first pass (4 acts, ~16 beats) authored to exercise the voxpaper skin: archival plates, portrait boxes, isotype grid, quote beats. Full 3-5 min authoring per voxbio SKILL.md. Durations are estimates until generate_audio.py runs. Facts to verify at Gate 1: von Jolly anecdote wording, Nobel 1901-1918 prize count (17, none in 1916), Erwin Planck 1945, 'act of desperation' letter (to R.W. Wood, 1931), autobiography quote.
